about: The line right under the closed request has a colon after [AGENT], which the settled form leaves out (spec-run-manager.md 08.4 item 1: 'with no colon'). It is link-line-invalid (spec-edit-guard.md 04 table). The close has no valid link line under it, so it is also close-invalid (04 item 6). Fixture worker's reading: a line added right under a request in the requests file is that request's link line, whatever its form, so it is judged by link-line-invalid rather than unexplained-change.
